title: Marlowe Rewards Programme Terms: Joining the Programme
content:
**1. Membership.** Any customer with a Marlowe & Finch profile may join Marlowe Rewards free of charge.

**2. Opening state.** A new membership always opens:

- at the tier Marlowe Rewards Member;
- in status active;
- with a tier start date equal to the enrolment date;
- with the tier valid through 31 December of the year after the enrolment year;
- with a points balance of zero before the welcome bonus posts.

**3. Minimum age.** A membership is opened only if the customer is at least 192 calendar months old (sixteen years) on the enrolment date, counted from the date of birth on the customer profile. The evidence is the date of birth recorded on the profile.

- Age is counted in whole calendar months from the date of birth.
- When the birth day does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used.
- The enrolment date may equal the resulting date.

**4. No second open membership.** A membership is opened only if the customer has no other membership in status active or suspended.

**5. Re-enrolment.** A customer whose earlier membership is closed may enrol again. The new membership starts at Marlowe Rewards Member with no points carried over. The earlier membership's forfeited points are never restored.

**6. Spend before joining.** Spend placed before enrolment never earns points retroactively. The one exception is the missing-points rule, for orders placed under the same customer profile.

### Clause 3, worked on hypothetical dates

| Date of birth on the profile | Enrolment date | Whole calendar months reached | Clause 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2009 | 14 March 2025 | 192 | Met, because the enrolment date may equal the date reached |
| 14 March 2009 | 13 March 2025 | 191 | Not met |
| 29th of a February, where the target February has 28 days | the 28th of that February | 192 | Met, because the last day of the month stands in for the missing 29th |

### Clauses 3 and 4 together

A membership opens only when both hold. The age must be met on the profile's date of birth, and no other membership of the customer may be in status active or suspended. If either fails, no membership is opened. An earlier membership in status closed does not prevent enrolment.
